content.user_title: Prepare Floor Plans for an External CAD Studio
content.value_statement: Floor-plan ideas need clear dimensions and room requirements before drafting. This skill collects a brief and prepares a link to an external CAD studio.
actual_capabilities: Collect building type, room requirements, dimensions, storeys, and plot details in the user's words.
Ask at most one clarification question when building type or size is missing.
Call prepare_cad_drawing_link through the AI Architectures connector to prepare an external studio link.
Return the studio link with attribution parameters and explain where users can attach a sketch.
Route the brief to a studio described as producing layered CAD plans with DXF, DWG, and PDF outputs.
limitations: Requires the external AI Architectures connector and service; no local drafting implementation is included.
Prepares a handoff link rather than directly generating or downloading CAD files in the conversation.
Service pricing, retention policies, and export availability are not documented in the skill.
Drawings are concepts, not permit or construction documents, and require professional review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Home Layout Brief
use_cases.description: Organize room counts, dimensions, and plot requirements before continuing in the external CAD studio.

use_cases.title: Hand Off an Interior Sketch
use_cases.description: Prepare a measured room brief and receive a studio link where a sketch can be attached.
use_cases.target_user: Interior designers preparing an initial layout

use_cases.title: Start a CAD Concept Study
use_cases.description: Capture storeys, building size, and room requirements for an external concept drawing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Floor Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a CAD studio link for a single-storey, 80-square-metre home with two bedrooms, one bathroom, and an open kitchen.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: provide a basic building brief.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Sketch Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a studio link for my 6-by-8-metre office sketch. Include a meeting room and two work areas, and identify where to attach it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: pair a measured brief with a sketch attachment.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Two-Storey Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a two-storey home brief for a 10-by-20-metre plot. Request three bedrooms upstairs and shared living spaces downstairs. Keep all measurements in metres.

prompt_templates.title: Review Requirements Before Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize my supplied room schedule, dimensions, storeys, and plot constraints without inventing measurements. Confirm what will reach AI Architectures before submitting the brief.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review a detailed brief and control external disclosure.

output_examples.input: Prepare a CAD workflow for an 80-square-metre home with two bedrooms and one bathroom.
output: Expected handoff: a Plan Chat studio link containing the prepared floor-plan brief.
The user continues on the site; the skill states drawing and charging begin only after pressing send.
Concept dimensions and local requirements need professional review.

output_examples.input: I have a sketch of a 6-by-8-metre office with a meeting room and two work areas.
output: Expected handoff: a studio link prepared from the office dimensions and room requirements.
Attach the sketch on the studio site before sending the brief.
The external studio is described as supporting layered CAD plans and DXF, DWG, and PDF outputs.

best_practices: Provide consistent units, room sizes, storeys, and plot dimensions before requesting the studio link.
Review the external service and authorize brief submission before sharing confidential property details.
Verify generated dimensions and local requirements with a licensed professional before construction.
anti_patterns: Treating the prepared link as a completed CAD drawing or guaranteed export.
Submitting confidential plans or identifying property details without authorization for external processing.
Using concept drawings as permit or construction documents without professional review.

faq.question: Does this skill draw CAD files locally?
faq.answer: No. It prepares a brief and hands it to the external Plan Chat CAD studio through a connector.

faq.question: Which export formats are described?
faq.answer: The skill describes layered CAD plans with DXF, DWG, and PDF outputs from the external studio.

faq.question: Can I include a sketch?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow tells users to attach a sketch on the studio site before sending the brief.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The prepare_cad_drawing_link tool must be available through the AI Architectures connector. The documented setup command targets Claude's MCP configuration.

faq.question: When does drawing or charging begin?
faq.answer: The skill states that neither begins until the user presses send on the site. Pricing and billing details are not documented.

faq.question: Does my brief leave the assistant environment?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow sends the brief through an external MCP tool before site confirmation. Review service policies before including sensitive information.
